cards.title: At 10 DME: turn to ~035°
instructions: Stay outside the Central eastern boundary
Maintain a 3 NM stand-off from KRAS and from Point Shamrock
Turn inbound to the area 500 ft before your designated altitude
If the climb will take you north of Central, make a right 270° climbing turn to enter at your assigned altitude. Do not enter Mustang Area 2
If you have not reached your altitude by the southern boundary of Area 2, make a right 270° turn to continue the climb before entering Central

cards.title: Switch to CH 18 and self-announce
cards.leadIn: Auto-switch to Central Common · UHF CH 18 and self-announce:
cards.detail: Example altitude: 7,500. You make only this call; there is no roll call for you to initiate. The binder notes other flights will execute a roll call from the bottom working block to the top.
